items.Sentence: Treatment consists of screening, aerated grit removal...
primary sedimentation by circular and rectangular clarifiers
biological treatment by trickling filters followed by activated sludge aeration basins, secondary clarification
operates the storage basin like an equalization basin to reduce discharges of blended effluent
disinfection by chlorination, and dechlorination by sodium bisulfite
treats its biosolids by gravity thickening or co-settling, lime stabilization, and dewatering by belt-filter presses
stabilized, dewatered biosolids are hauled offsite for land application at the Discharger’s Biosolids Utilization Project on Tubbs Island
began sending a small portion of its biosolids to the Lystek Organic Material Recovery Center ... for incorporation into Lystek’s biosolids-deriv
